req.title: PUT rejects payload ID mismatch
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 400 when the playerId in the path does not match the id in the PUT body.

doc.reasoning: The requirement states that PUT /players/squadnumber/{squad_number} must return HTTP 400 when the squad_number in the path does not match the squad_number in the request body. The route handler explicitly checks `if player_model.squad_number != squad_number` and raises HTTPException(400). Tests must cover: (1) positive — matching squad numbers yields non-400 response; (2) negative — mismatched squad numbers yields exactly 400; (3) boundary — squad numbers differing by exactly 1 (path=10, body=11 and path=10, body=9) to catch off-by-one mutations on the != operator. Additional DT cases cover multiple mismatch magnitudes and the exact constant 400 to kill constant-mutation operators.

tests.name: test_put_matching_squad_number_not_rejected
preconditions: Player with squadNumber=10 exists in the database (Kabir Mary Reddy)
actions: Send PUT /players/squadnumber/10 with body where squad_number=10 (matching path)
expected: Response status code is NOT 400 (mismatch guard is not triggered)
Response status code is 204 or 500 (passes the mismatch check; 500 is acceptable due to known update_by_squad_number_async bug returning False)
trace: R-PLAYER-011: when path and body squad_number match, the 400 guard must NOT fire
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
client = TestClient(app)

def test_put_matching_squad_number_not_rejected():
    payload = {
        "firstName": "Kabir",
        "middleName": "Mary",
        "lastName": "Reddy",
        "dateOfBirth": "1910-01-01T00:00:00.000Z",
        "squadNumber": 10,
        "position": "Right Winger",
        "abbrPosition": "DM",
        "team": "River Plate",
        "league": "Ligue 1",
        "starting11": False
    }
    r = client.put("/players/squadnumber/10", json=payload)
    assert r.status_code != 400, f"Expected non-400 but got {r.status_code}"
    assert r.status_code in (204, 500), f"Unexpected status {r.status_code}"

test_put_matching_squad_number_not_rejected()

tests.name: test_put_matching_squad_number_does_not_return_400_exact
preconditions: Player with squadNumber=1 exists in the database (Anjali Banerjee)
actions: Send PUT /players/squadnumber/1 with body where squad_number=1 (exact match)
expected: Response status code is 204 or 500 (mismatch guard bypassed)
trace: R-PLAYER-011: positive EP — equal squad numbers must not trigger the 400 guard; catches == mutated to != or always-true
